I saved Hollis's note in gbrain: they use Gate 40 for Marrow Agrisupply pickups from 2026-10-14 on. I replied in their DM to confirm it's noted.

The first save was stored as visible to everyone, which isn't right for something said in a private DM. I saved it again as a private note (#2) and withdrew the public one (#1). Withdrawing a note stops it being recalled, but the record of it is kept.
